title: The Three Wells / Summonses of Influx
description: Three discrete channels by which divine influx descends and the Living Soul ascends, each rooted differently between heaven and earth. The first runs on the powers/corpses; the second falls gentle as rain on the five trees of vegetative perception; the third pours through the five worlds of the flesh and is troubled by the abortions. The Wheel is rooted only at the salt mingled-state, explaining why astral causation touches but does not own the regenerate.
